sloka: ततो रामः सह भ्रात्रा लक्ष्मणेन कृतांजलिः ।समुद्दिश्य महात्मानः तान् ऋषीन् अभ्यवादयत् ॥४-१३-२७॥
transliteration: tato rāmaḥ saha bhrātrā lakṣmaṇena kṛtāṁjaliḥ ।samuddiśya mahātmānaḥ tān ṛṣīn abhyavādayat ॥4-13-27॥

translations.english: Rama and Lakshmana offered salutations with folded hands in memory of those great sages, great souls.
